source_summary: Tall ink-and-light-color landscape with an open misty lake, distant pale hills, a diagonal flock of birds, a small scholar seated in a skiff, and a large leafless autumn tree-and-rock bank at the lower right. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif bank.

motifs.name: misty_right_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant mountain mass on the upper right: a softly outlined rounded ridge emerging through mist, with very light tan-gray wash and nearly dry contour edges. Exclude nearby birds and seals.
must_preserve: subtle tonal variation without hard texture

motifs.name: low_left_shoreline
motifs.description: Isolate the low distant shoreline across the left middle distance, including the faint hill silhouette, horizontal water bands, and mottled tree masses along the bank. Exclude open paper field above and the nearby tree cluster to the right.

motifs.name: diagonal_flying_geese
motifs.description: Isolate the diagonal stream of small black birds crossing the central sky, from the high scattered birds down to the denser middle flock. Capture each bird as quick dark ink wing marks; exclude mountain wash and tree branches below.
must_preserve: variation in bird size and spacing
diagonal movement from upper right to lower left
dark ink accents against empty sky

motifs.name: scholar_in_skiff
motifs.description: Isolate the small seated scholar in a narrow skiff near the lower left-center water. Include the robed figure, dark head and shoulder linework, small hand/rod gesture, and the long shallow boat strokes. Exclude surrounding blank water except immediate support strokes.
must_preserve: fine angular arm or pole line

motifs.name: main_leafless_tree_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the tall leafless tree cluster on the right: multiple pale trunks rising upward with dense forked branches, gray twig networks, and dark ink branch accents. Exclude the foreground rock base as much as possible while keeping visible trunks and branch brushwork.

motifs.name: left_sweeping_bare_shrub
motifs.description: Isolate the lower sweeping bare shrub/tree mass extending leftward from the central bank, with fanlike pale branches and small dotted foliage texture. Keep the arcing branch structure distinct from the taller right tree trunks.

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right rocky bank supporting the trees, including angular boulders, dark shrub clusters, root-like strokes, and pale gray rock planes. Exclude the scholar boat and upper tree canopy.
must_preserve: strong black dry-brush accents at the base

motifs.name: misty_lake_surface
motifs.description: Isolate the open misty lake surface in the lower and middle left, defined by sparse horizontal washes and soft blank-water intervals. Exclude the skiff, figure, distant shoreline, and foreground bank while preserving the subtle water strokes.
must_preserve: minimal ink texture suitable for recomposition

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
